items.title: Bounded BV data on the real line
items.statement: The bounded, locally integrable translation-variation class BV_b(R), with no L1(R) tail requirement.

items.title: Monotone finite-volume scheme and invariant-interval CFL
items.statement: A locally Lipschitz, consistent, coordinatewise monotone two-point flux and conservative cell-average update under the full invariant-interval CFL bound lambda(L1+L2)<=1.

items.title: Piecewise-linear time interpolant of a finite-volume scheme
items.statement: The affine-in-time, cellwise-constant reconstruction between consecutive monotone finite-volume states.

items.title: Invariant range, TVD and time increments for a monotone finite-volume update
items.statement: The full CFL makes the update map isotone and constant-preserving, giving invariant range, discrete TVD and a summed time-increment bound.

items.title: Discrete Kruzhkov inequality for a monotone finite-volume scheme
items.statement: The Crandall–Majda numerical entropy flux G_k yields the exact one-step discrete Kruzhkov inequality for every real entropy level.

items.title: Local compactness and initial trace for BV finite-volume states
items.statement: A rational-point diagonal plus temporal translation bound gives local strong compactness, the exact initial trace, and a common limit of affine and piecewise-constant reconstructions.

items.title: Strong entropy convergence of monotone finite-volume schemes
items.statement: For scalar C1 flux and bounded BV data, a consistent monotone locally Lipschitz flux under the full invariant CFL and positive lower time-to-space ratio converges strongly locally to the unique Kruzhkov solution, with separate DC and non-DC data branches.

items.title: A consistent nonmonotone flux selects a nonentropy expansion shock
items.statement: A smooth consistent shared-face flux with negative first derivative at (-1,0) preserves a strongly convergent stationary Burgers expansion shock that violates the k=0 Kruzhkov inequality.

items.title: Burgers Godunov flux under the invariant-interval CFL bound
items.statement: On [-M,M], the Burgers Godunov flux is coordinatewise monotone and M-Lipschitz in each coordinate, so lambda<=1/(2M) satisfies the full CFL and the convergence theorem applies.

items.title: Lax–Friedrichs flux under the invariant-interval CFL bound
items.statement: With alpha>=sup_I|f'|, the Lax–Friedrichs flux has coordinate Lipschitz constants (L+alpha)/2 and is monotone; lambda(L+alpha)<=1 yields convergence under the theorem.

items.title: Godunov scheme captures a stationary Burgers entropy shock
items.statement: The aligned 1-to--1 Burgers shock has common Godunov face flux 1/2, is stationary at every grid level, has Rankine–Hugoniot speed zero, and satisfies every Kruzhkov inequality.
